Catalan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Latin corrigere, with normal change of conjugation to -ir.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central) [ku.rəˈʒi]
  • IPA(key): (Balearic) [ko.rəˈʒi]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [ko.reˈd͡ʒiɾ]
  • Audio (Barcelona):(file)

Verb

[edit]

corregir (first-person singular present corregeixo, first-person singular preterite corregí, past participle corregit)

  1. to correct

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Latin corrigere.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /koreˈxiɾ/ [ko.reˈxiɾ]
  • Audio (Colombia):(file)
  • Rhymes: -iɾ
  • Syllabification: co‧rre‧gir

Verb

[edit]

corregir (first-person singular present corrijo, first-person singular preterite corregí, past participle corregido)

  1. (transitive) to correct
    Synonyms: enmendar, rectificar
